notes: Point is Mathews Tuya, not the field centroid; source precision 0.001°. Glacial tag records Pleistocene eruption conditions. Biosignatures are a research target, not confirmed here. Radius 5 km is the sheet default. Modern ice and subsurface unverified.

sampling.method: 5 km circular Earth Engine area; annual MODIS composite means

limits: Earth measurements use 2023 annual MODIS means over a 5 km circular area. The supplied pipeline did not apply MODIS QA-bit filtering.
The Earth thermal proxy is (1 − albedo) / (mean day LST − mean night LST). It is not physical thermal inertia; day and night are separate annual composite means.
Thermal scores are relative ranks within the supplied catalog for each planet. Earth thermal scores above 60° absolute latitude are excluded.

Terrain slope and its standard deviation use a DEM aggregated to nominal 463 m in a geographic projection; physical east–west sampling varies with latitude. DEM acquisition dates differ from the 2023 MODIS period.
Modern ice is unverified in the research notes and is excluded from scoring. A glacial geology tag can refer to ancient formation conditions.

sampling.method: Existing Mars pipeline: single-pixel elevation/albedo and square pixel neighbourhoods

limits: Mars elevation and albedo are single-pixel samples; slope, slope standard deviation, SWIM and thermal inertia use the supplied pipeline’s square pixel neighbourhoods. Their physical east–west extent varies with latitude.
Mars exploration zones generally use a 25 km nominal neighbourhood, while Earth measurements use a 5 km circular area. Dataset resolutions and acquisition dates differ.
SWIM values express consistency with subsurface ice, not an ice probability or measured ice fraction. Missing map coverage remains unavailable.
